messages:
jane_cs: Quick Mellonix check-in — noticing a spike in p99 on the streaming path for their primary route (/chat-assist). p95 looks fine. Can we do a quick triage? I'm worried this will surface in their onboarding demos tomorrow.

sam_sre: Looking now. Initial glance: streaming /chat-assist p99 jumped from ~220ms -> ~520ms in the last 12h. Sync route stable. No planned infra changes on our side.

li_obs: Pasting a short snapshot from the dashboard (last 24h):
```
route           | model            | mode      | p95  | p99  
/chat-assist     | gpt-open-1-q8    | streaming  | 210ms | 520ms
/chat-assist     | gpt-open-1-q8    | sync       | 200ms | 235ms
/chat-assist     | gpt-3.8-base     | streaming  | 260ms | 580ms
/rerank         | gpt-3.8-base     | streaming  | 180ms | 210ms
```
Also seeing a small uptick in 5xxs on the streaming socket related code path (0.14% -> 0.6%).

deploy-bot: deploy:prod completed by @sam_sre at 08:45 (commit `abc1234`), automated rollout 08:50 -> 09:00 :package_deploy: 

alex_mellonix: We noticed slowdowns around 09:30 PST in our QA. We enabled session affinity + client-side streaming windowing last week — could that interact? Some users reported repeated small chunks.

sam_sre: Good call. I see a pattern where many short-fragment streams cause frequent flushes and increase syscall overhead on the streaming worker. Also a few requests with long context (~12k tokens) hit a fallback codepath we recently added.

li_obs: Correlation: increased small-chunk streams + fallback to slow decoder kernel -> p99 tail. We can test two mitigations: 1) increase streaming buffer threshold to reduce flush frequency, 2) tweak fallback thresholds for long-context handling.

jane_cs: Risk to renewal? Usage is +12% MoM and spend is healthy, but user experience for demos is high impact. Marking renewal risk = medium until p99 is back under 300ms.

sam_sre: Plan: push config bump (stream buffer threshold + prefer-fast-kernel for borderline contexts) as a canary to 5% traffic by 15:00 PST, monitor for 30m, then 20% if green. I'll include a short rollback.

li_obs: I'll create a temporary dashboard that splits p95/p99 by mode+model+route and add an alert: p99 streaming /chat-assist > 350ms for 5m. I'll also log the client chunk-size distribution.

jane_cs: Action items summarized: @sam_sre deploy config canary by 15:00 PST; @li_obs watch p99 + enable alert; I'll draft a short customer note for Mellonix CSW to explain we're investigating and will follow up with root cause.

alex_mellonix: Appreciate the quick follow-up. Will let our PMs know — they were prepping the demo. Keep me posted here and by email if anything changes. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: Started the canary at 15:02 (5%): `kubectl annotate rollout/mellonix-streaming canary=active` — watching now.

li_obs: 15:10 update: p99 dropped to ~270ms on canary shards, 5xx rate back to baseline. Propagating to 20% at 15:25.

jane_cs: Great work all. I'll close the loop with Mellonix and note improvement + temporary mitigation. We'll keep medium risk note until we ship the fallback kernel fix in next full release. :eyes:
